public_rationale: Sightline's public research confirms an earlier estimate of about 5GW under construction among projects scheduled for 2026. It does not verify the separate April claim of 15.2GW out of 114GW scheduled through 2028. The exact figures remain unverified, rather than disproved.
limitations: The available primary summary predates the target period.
The underlying project dataset requires access not provided by the public report-request page.

public_payload.normalized_proposition: Of 114GW of AI data center capacity announced for completion by end-2028, only 15.2GW is under construction.

statement.excerpt: I reached out to Sightline to get some clarity, and they told me that of the 114GW of capacity due to come online by the end of 2028, only 15.2GW is under construction, including the 5GW due in 2026.

from_speaker: 114GW of capacity due to come online by the end of 2028
our_interpretation: This describes construction status at the time of the post. End-2028 identifies the scheduled-completion cohort, not a forecast deadline.
Because the statement reports fresh correspondence and a current construction snapshot, use April 2026 through the post date as the reporting period.
Test the figures within Sightline's project universe. Do not silently treat its tracked projects as a complete census of every data center worldwide.
Allow ordinary rounding to the precision stated.
criteria.support_condition: A dated Sightline snapshot or independently reproducible project inventory shows approximately 114GW scheduled through end-2028, of which approximately 15.2GW was under construction, including approximately 5GW scheduled for 2026.
criteria.contradiction_condition: A comparable snapshot for the same dates, project universe, construction definition and power measure gives materially different totals.
